conceptZh: 一隻卡通蜈蚣玩具坐在地上努力穿鞋，一隻、兩隻、三隻…穿到第五隻就累到整個癱平，後面還有一長排鞋子在等；一台小機器人走過來，默默幫牠穿上第六隻，牠感動地舉起一隻腳。
object: a cartoon toy centipede, a long row of tiny shoes and a small toy robot
morph: the glyph 腳 stands still as a solid sculpture while the centipede struggles into its shoes below
creativeAngle: 用「腳太多、鞋穿不完」把字義變成具體的數量笑話，六歲孩子一看就懂，結尾機器人出手幫忙也很溫暖。腳為肉月旁加卻共十三畫，字體靜止保結構。語音詞「腳踏車」是三字詞，腳ㄐㄧㄠˇ、踏ㄊㄚˋ、車ㄔㄜ都是單一讀音，車也已經學過。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid light cream background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 腳 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep plum, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the 月 flesh radical on the left and the 卻 component on the right stay clearly separated, with the small 卩 at the far right kept upright and readable. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Along its base sits a cheerful cartoon toy centipede surrounded by a long row of tiny shoes stretching off to the right. From 0.5 seconds it works away with great enthusiasm, pulling a shoe onto one foot, then the next, then the next, counting each one with a happy little nod. By 2.2 seconds it has managed five and the pace has visibly collapsed; its arms droop, it looks at the remaining row of shoes, looks at the camera, and flops flat onto the floor with its many legs splayed. Hold that beat. At 3.2 seconds a small boxy toy robot walks in from the left, crouches without a word, and carefully fits shoe number six onto the nearest foot. The centipede lifts that single shod leg into the air in grateful triumph. The two of them potter out of frame to the left by 4.6 seconds. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 腳 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「腳、腳、腳踏車」, using the reading ㄐㄧㄠˇ for 腳 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 腳 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 腳踏車 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 腳: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.
